name: @lolkda/dsh-dexsql-mcp

tools.name: close_dataset
tools.description: Close a dataset and release its worker. New requests fail; already accepted requests may finish, with deadlines still enforced.

tools.name: decode
tools.description: Inspect a method or class. Exactly one method descriptor, method_idx (with file_id), or class descriptor is required. Classes default to paginated summaries; methods default to paginated smali. Follow next_offset for exact text continuation; context mode lists original line numbers for labels and catch directives. Query SQL tables for annotations and debug metadata.

compact.description:
Opt in to one structuredContent representation (content is empty). Query columns become
names and cells use null/string/number or [i|u|b|f, string]; SQL is omitted. Default false.

max_lines.description: Maximum lines in one text page, default 200, maximum 1000.

method.description: Exact DEX descriptor. Supply exactly one of method, method_idx, or class.

method_limit.description: Methods per class page, default 20, maximum 50.

method_offset.description: Class method-list offset, ordered by method_idx.

mode.description: Defaults to summary for a class, smali for a method. Context lists original label/catch lines.

offset.description: UTF-8 byte offset into one method's smali/context text; continue with next_offset.

DecodeMode.description:
Which `decode` view a request asks for. A class selection defaults to [`Self::Summary`] and a
method selection to [`Self::Smali`] (see [`run`]).

`JsonSchema` is derived here for the same reason as `apk::manifest::ManifestMode`: the MCP tool's
parameter schema is generated from this type (it is re-exported as
`cli::mcp::protocol::DecodeMode`), so the published schema and the implemented behaviour cannot
disagree.

oneOf.description: Method METADATA only: descriptor, access flags, code units, registers, try count.
The complete smali text of each selected method, paged by UTF-8 byte offset.

The smali text with every original label/catch/method line prefixed by its zero-based line
number — the view a caller uses to talk about a line it saw somewhere else.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Describe a built-in SQL table or view; no dataset is needed.

tools.name: get_manifest
tools.description: Read an APK Manifest as a summary (including paged permissions) or paged decoded XML. input_index refers to open_dataset.inputs; choose it when several archives are open. Does not require DEX or Java decompilation.

compact.description:
Opt in to one structuredContent representation (content is empty). Query columns become
names and cells use null/string/number or [i|u|b|f, string]; SQL is omitted. Default false.

input_index.description: Index in open_dataset.inputs; required when several archive inputs are present.

offset.description: Permission-row offset in summary mode, UTF-8 byte offset in XML mode.

ManifestMode.description:
Which `AndroidManifest.xml` view a `get_manifest` request asks for.

`JsonSchema` is derived here because the MCP tool definition is generated from this type (it is
re-exported as `cli::mcp::protocol::ManifestMode`), so the published parameter schema and the
implemented behaviour cannot disagree.

oneOf.description:
Structured summary: manifest/application/uses-sdk attributes, target SDK, component counts,
and a paged `permissions` list.
The complete decoded XML, paged by UTF-8 byte offset.

tools.name: get_manifest_components
tools.description: Page Manifest components, names/descriptors, launcher intent filters, aliases and exported configuration. Exported state is manifest-derived and is not a claim of runtime accessibility. Includes explicit and SDK-dependent default states.

compact.description:
Opt in to one structuredContent representation (content is empty). Query columns become
names and cells use null/string/number or [i|u|b|f, string]; SQL is omitted. Default false.

kind.description: Optional activity, activity-alias, service, receiver, or provider filter.

only_exported.description: Filter by manifest-derived exported state; does not imply runtime accessibility.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: List open datasets and server quotas/usage. Counts include opening datasets and accepted work still holding a closed dataset.

tools.name: list_resource_files
tools.description: Page archive entry names and sizes, optionally filtered by prefix (res/, assets/, lib/). Names identify entries for read_resource; files are never extracted.

compact.description:
Opt in to one structuredContent representation (content is empty). Query columns become
names and cells use null/string/number or [i|u|b|f, string]; SQL is omitted. Default false.

prefix.description: Case-sensitive archive-entry prefix, for example res/layout/ or assets/.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List all built-in SQL tables and views; no dataset is needed.

tools.name: open_dataset
tools.description: Open local DEX/APK/JAR/ZIP paths as an isolated reusable dataset. Resource-only archives are supported. Input/session quotas and operation deadlines apply. Close unused datasets to release memory.

inputs.description: Local DEX/APK/JAR/ZIP paths, resolved relative to the server working directory.

timeout_ms.description: Optional shorter operation deadline; cannot exceed the server's timeout.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Run a read-only SQL batch with exact typed cells, byte/row budgets and per-statement next_offset. Use stable ORDER BY when paging; SQL is re-executed against the current lazy session definitions on each page; CREATE definitions persist until DROP, replacement or dataset close. Running timeout/cancellation closes only this dataset. Use resources/list to discover the documentation.

compact.description:
Opt in to one structuredContent representation (content is empty). Query columns become
names and cells use null/string/number or [i|u|b|f, string]; SQL is omitted. Default false.

limit.description: Returned rows per statement, default 200; use a deterministic ORDER BY when paging.

max_bytes.description: Optional lower serialized result-byte budget; rows are never silently clipped.

named_temp_queries.description: Lazy named SELECT definitions, retained in this dataset with the same lifetime as TEMP tables.

offset.description: Rows to skip in each statement's result, default 0. offset + limit is at most 100000.

sql.description:
Read-only SQL statements. VIEW and TEMP definitions are lazy and persist in this dataset
until DROP, redefinition, or close_dataset; results are not cached across calls.

tools.name: query_resources
tools.description: Query resources.arsc by numeric ID, exact type/name, type, name substring or configuration. Returns matching configurations with raw values and named references; complex resources are flattened into ordered map items. Separate from DEX strings.

compact.description:
Opt in to one structuredContent representation (content is empty). Query columns become
names and cells use null/string/number or [i|u|b|f, string]; SQL is omitted. Default false.

configuration.description: Exact qualifier string from a previous result. Empty string selects the default config.

contains.description: Case-sensitive substring of the resource name.

name.description: Exact type/name or package:type/name, for example string/app_name.

resource_type.description: Resource type, for example string, layout, id, style, or array.

tools.name: read_resource
tools.description: Read one exact APK archive entry in bounded pages. Binary Android XML is decoded; UTF-8 text is preserved; other bytes use hex. Follow next_offset in page (text) or the result (hex). The resource-entry size quota applies before decompression.

compact.description:
Opt in to one structuredContent representation (content is empty). Query columns become
names and cells use null/string/number or [i|u|b|f, string]; SQL is omitted. Default false.

name.description: Exact archive entry name. No files are extracted to the filesystem.

offset.description: Byte offset in decoded UTF-8 text, or original bytes when encoding is hex.

ResourceFormat.description:
The `read_resource` output format: decide from the bytes, or force hex.

`JsonSchema` is derived here for the same reason as `manifest::ManifestMode`: the MCP tool's
parameter schema is generated from this type, which is re-exported as
`cli::mcp::protocol::ResourceFormat`.

instructions: Analyze Android DEX/APK using read-only SQL, paged smali and APK Manifest/resources. Use resources/list for the complete English documentation catalog, including unlinked pages. Read relevant pages using the URIs returned by the catalog. Inspect the schema, open_dataset, then query/decode or resource tools. Reuse dataset_id and close unused datasets. Follow next_offset; query paging re-executes SQL and needs stable ORDER BY. Classes default to method summaries. Running timeout/cancellation closes that dataset; reopen it to continue. list_datasets reports quotas. int64/uint64 cells are exact decimal strings.
